text: This report provides an update to the Board of Health on the Toronto Public Health Capital Budget Variance for the year ended on December 31, 2020. As of December 31, 2020, Toronto Public Health spent $1,587.3 thousand representing 25.5 percent of the 2020 Approved Capital Budget of $6,217.3 thousand. The majority of planned 2020 capital projects were deferred due to resources being deployed to support Toronto Public Health's COVID-19 response.
The Board of Health: 1. Received the report (April 25, 2021) from the Medical Officer of Health for information.
